evidence_limitations: Retained artifact drift detection is not tamper-proof against coordinated rewriting of the summary and all referenced artifacts.
checksums.txt bytes and native CHECK result are bound; checksum serialization is opaque to this reconciler.
Offline gates replay artifacts without rerunning native commands; root separately executed both fresh native runs.
Temporary evidence must remain available for refresh; the committed packet is an index, not the evidence bytes.

triggers: Affected source/spec, inherited profile or physical layout changes
decay.refresh: Rerun affected DEBUG/RELEASE gates, fresh helpers and paired native whole/path gates for implementation changes; rerun offline self-test, actual CLI controls and reconciliation for offline-only consumer changes.
decay.failure_policy: Reopen dependent compatibility claims; retain the last confirmed frontier and failed roots without widening admission.
